body.message:
We have shared your request with the management team. However, due to their busy schedule, we have not yet been able to connect with them for further feedback.

Please note that any update received will not change the terms of the agreement, and it will remain the same contract that was previously shared with you. If you would still like to speak with the management, we kindly request your patience while we await their response.

We would also like to inform you that, as we have not yet received your confirmation, we have released the apartment from hold. Unfortunately, we are unable to reserve the unit for a longer period without confirmation.

Thank you very much for your understanding and patience.
